description: This file contains functions for anonymizing or redacting personally identifiable information (PII) in calendar events, bookings, credentials, calendars, event types, and user data within a scheduling application.

methods.name: getBooleanStatus
methods.description: Returns a boolean status string prefixed with 'PiiFree:' in production environment, or the original value otherwise.

methods.name: getPiiFreeCalendarEvent
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields in a CalendarEvent object, replacing certain properties with boolean status indicators.

methods.name: getPiiFreeBooking
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields in a booking object, especially the title.

methods.name: getPiiFreeCredential
methods.description: Redacts sensitive credential information, especially the key and delegatedTo fields.

methods.name: getPiiFreeSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields in a SelectedCalendar object, truncating externalId and masking credentialId.

methods.name: getPiiFreeDestinationCalendar
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields in a DestinationCalendar object, especially externalId.

methods.name: getPiiFreeEventType
methods.description: Returns selected properties of an EventType object.

methods.name: getPiiFreeUser
methods.description: Redacts sensitive user information, including credentials and destinationCalendar.
